performance.verdict: CPL win is real but 7 leads in 28 days signals a volume crisis, not health.

findings.text: CPL dropped 49.93% week-over-week, but only 7 leads landed in 28 days — efficiency improved on a near-zero volume base, masking structural underperformance.

6 overdue SOW milestones: intake owner unconfirmed (blocks scale-up), LSA heating toggles off since 2026-09-01, booking bot battle-test, Review Boost, financing page, and Homer Glen branch all undelivered.
'Quality HVAC by Fibid' GBP generated 187 impressions over 28 days but 0 calls and 0 directions — call button or listing config is broken, suppressing organic lead volume entirely.

3-day signal (Sep 8–10): leads = 1, 0, 0 vs prior 3 days (Sep 5–7): leads = 1, 1, 0 — flat near-zero. Search clicks also hit 0 for Sep 7–10, down from ~2/day prior; 80.95% sc_7d drop is a confirmed trend, not noise.

GHL shows 521 opportunities created vs 262 contacts and 39 won — opportunity count is implausibly 2× contacts, suggesting duplicate or auto-created opp records; pipeline data is unreliable as a lead-quality proxy.

suggestions.text: Audit and repair 'Quality HVAC by Fibid' GBP call button — 187 impressions and 0 calls over 28 days is a confirmed listing defect.
suggestions.monday_update: The 'Quality HVAC by Fibid' profile generated 187 impressions over the last 28 days but produced exactly 0 calls and 0 direction requests — the call button or primary phone number is misconfigured or suppressed. Audit the listing: verify the phone number is correct, call button is enabled, and the profile is not in a suspended or unverified state. Success is defined as ≥1 call recorded from this profile within 7 days of the fix. Re-check by 2026-09-18.
